subtitle: Out Manila · Juneyao Air
overview: Fly Manila to Shanghai on Juneyao Air for city sights, then continue by air to Jeju Island in South Korea for four days of coastlines, markets and drama filming locations. You return via Shanghai for the Old Shanghai-style 1192 street before flying home. Hotels are 4-star in Shanghai and 3-star on Jeju, with a private coach and English-speaking guide.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 24–Mar 1 2027 to Feb 24–Mar 1 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known pedestrian shopping street, running toward the Bund.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade, with historic buildings facing the modern Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's landmark TV tower in Pudong, with a photo stop on this tour.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A Taoist temple in Shanghai's old city, beside the Yu Garden bazaar area.
placeDesc.Xinchang Ancient Town: A canal-side ancient town near Shanghai, visited before the flight to Jeju.
placeDesc.Iho Tewoo Horse Lighthouse: Horse-shaped lighthouses on Iho beach in Jeju, a filming location of a Korean drama.
placeDesc.Dodu Rainbow Coastal Road: A colourful coastal road in Jeju city, known for its rainbow-striped kerb.
placeDesc.Yongduam Rock: A dragon-head-shaped volcanic rock on the coast of Jeju city, a filming spot of The Legend of the Blue Sea.
placeDesc.Seongsan Ilchulbong: A volcanic crater on Jeju's east coast, a UNESCO site known for sunrise views.
placeDesc.Haenyeo Village: A village on Jeju where the traditional female free-divers (haenyeo) live and work.
placeDesc.Seongeup Folk Village: A preserved traditional village on Jeju with thatched houses, a filming spot of Jewel in the Palace.
placeDesc.Arboretum Night Market: A night market in Jeju with food and souvenir stalls.
placeDesc.Gwaneumsa Temple: A Buddhist temple on the slopes of Mount Halla in Jeju.
placeDesc.Hallasan 1100 Highland: A high-altitude wetland area on the slope of Mount Halla, about 1,100 m above sea level.
placeDesc.Jeju-mok Government Office: A historic government office site in Jeju city, with old traditional buildings.
placeDesc.Dongmun Traditional Market: A long-running traditional market in Jeju city selling local food and goods.
placeDesc.Seaweed Museum: A museum-style stop in Jeju with a hanbok-wearing experience and kimchi making.
placeDesc.Osulloc Tea Museum: A tea museum and plantation on Jeju where green tea products can be tasted.
placeDesc.Oedolgae Rock: A lone sea stack standing off the south coast of Jeju.
placeDesc.Olle Trail: A scenic coastal walking trail network on Jeju island.
placeDesc.Yeondong Shopping Street: A busy shopping and dining street in Jeju city.
placeDesc.1192 Old Shanghai Style Street: A street in Shanghai styled after old Shanghai, visited before the flight home.
